circle.title: ga_00061121513373e1796c1aa2 fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for transcription factor regulatory range compared to alternative methods. status: unresolved

ga_134dcd647625e1e18ccfe217 gears outperforms baseline methods in predicting two-gene perturbation outcomes across all generalization classes with over 30% improvement in m.s.e. and 50% greater enrichment for top de genes. status: unresolved

ga_4cea6d18cf7afc8b423b822a the cropseq-guide-puro vector does not compromise lentiviral function or genome editing efficiency compared to the standard lentiguide-puro vector. status: unresolved

ga_860c722ce3971079fa082a4a scgpt outperforms scvi seurat and harmony in multi-batch integration. status: unresolved
